entries.description: At the exact Ceph 20.2.4 target, FileStore is rejected as no longer supported. requiredFacts.description: Whether one complete caller-selected current OSD metadata object with the explicitly matching numeric OSD id reports osd_objectstore=filestore; this says nothing about other OSDs or cluster inventory.

entries.description: Fluent Bit 4.0 changes the OpenTelemetry output http2 default from on to off; this checks only a complete caller-selected classic OUTPUT section and an explicit intent to preserve the previously enabled setting. It does not establish protocol negotiation, TLS, connectivity, collector behavior, or whole-upgrade compatibility.

requiredFacts.description: Whether the proposed effective OpenTelemetry output setting enables http2 (on or force) after strict bounded classic-config admission and explicit current-default/preservation declarations.

rule.nextAction: If preserving the previously enabled OpenTelemetry HTTP/2 setting, provide a complete effective classic OUTPUT section with http2 on or force; off or omission is blocked under that intent, while unsupported syntax remains UNKNOWN.

entries.description: Fluent Bit 5.1.2 target-only OpenTelemetry HTTP/2 requirement. It applies only when the caller explicitly requires HTTP/2 for the selected output; the target also permits HTTP/1.1, so this is neither a universal invalidity nor an origin-default preservation claim.

rule.nextAction: Because the selected output requires HTTP/2, provide complete caller-selected classic OUTPUT input with http2 on or force; off or omission is blocked only under that declared target requirement.

entries.description: Loki 3.0 removes two legacy string-valued compactor shared-store settings; this checks only their presence in one complete, precedence-resolved proposed native Loki YAML compactor mapping.

requiredFacts.description: Whether the proposed complete selected Loki compactor mapping contains shared_store or shared_store_key_prefix with a literal YAML string value.

rule.nextAction: Remove shared_store and shared_store_key_prefix from the selected compactor mapping, then separately follow Loki 3.0 storage, index, retention, and data-access migration guidance.

entries.description: Loki 3.0 requires structured metadata to use TSDB with schema v13; this checks only one complete, precedence-resolved selected schema period and does not establish runtime startup or data migration.

requiredFacts.description: Whether the selected proposed Loki schema and store violate the reviewed structured-metadata TSDB/v13 constraint.

rule.nextAction: Use schema v13 with tsdb, or disable allow_structured_metadata, then separately review Loki storage, index, retention, and data-access migration guidance.

entries.description: MariaDB 10.11.8 provides InnoDB defragmentation while 11.4.2 registers innodb-defragment only as a removed compatibility option that warns and does nothing. This checks only an explicit caller requirement for that removed behavior in the exact upstream transition; option presence alone never blocks startup.

requiredFacts.description: Whether the caller explicitly requires InnoDB defragmentation behavior to remain available in the proposed MariaDB target.
Whether the caller explicitly binds the selected configuration to the reviewed upstream MariaDB distribution.

rule.nextAction: Choose and verify an alternative to removed InnoDB defragmentation, or explicitly waive that behavior requirement. Deleting the ignored option alone does not restore the feature.

entries.description: MariaDB Operator 26.6.0 requires a Galera data-plane update before the operator update; this checks one complete caller-selected MariaDB resource and does not evaluate cluster state or controller completion.

requiredFacts.description: Whether the selected MariaDB resource explicitly declares spec.updateStrategy.autoUpdateDataPlane true.
Whether the selected MariaDB resource explicitly declares spec.galera.enabled true.
Whether the caller explicitly declares the check is before the operator update.
Whether the selected MariaDB resource declares the separate spec.replication.enabled mode; true means Galera-only scope does not apply.
Whether the caller explicitly declares the selected MariaDB resource complete.

rule.nextAction: For a selected Galera-only MariaDB resource, set spec.updateStrategy.autoUpdateDataPlane: true before updating the operator; review standalone, replication, admission, runtime readiness, and data-plane completion separately.
